core.notes: This feed applies module-safe public-readiness upgrades to APEX 2.51.1. Core Electron/runtime and code-signing changes require a rebuilt EXE and are intentionally not delivered by the module updater.

display.name: APEX Display & Touch Suite
display.description: Display + Touch Suite 4.2.2: touchscreen grid itself now enters fullscreen edge-to-edge, removing the surrounding laboratory panels so every grid area can be touched across the whole display.

keyboard.name: APEX Keyboard Lab
keyboard.description: APEX Keyboard Lab 1.1: polished professional keyboard diagnostics with fully centred key labels, refined key geometry, cleaner surrounding UI and APEX violet/cyan verified states replacing the previous green styling.

media.name: APEX Original Camera / Sound
media.description: Restores the original Camera, Speakers and Microphone page and removes the obsolete Application Mode / Browser Mode selector UI from the desktop tool.

battery.name: APEX Battery Lab - Clean Full Width Summary
battery.description: Battery Lab 2.1.3 fixes the Power Test summary band so all six cards span the full available width without cramped left-side layout.

system.name: APEX Hardware & Storage Tabbed Section
system.description: Keeps one Hardware section in the sidebar and adds two clean internal pages, Hardware and Storage, each with its own original scan action and results area.

report.name: APEX Professional Functional Reports
report.description: Public-readiness report overhaul: strict overall PASS / FAIL / REVIEW REQUIRED verdicts, Pass/Fail/Review/Not Tested/N/A states, verification source and evidence counts, APEX branding, dynamic core versioning, JSON/CSV evidence exports, and frozen SHA-256 final-report snapshots.

gauntlet.name: APEX Decision Integrity
gauntlet.description: Corrects advanced diagnostic decision integrity so scores 65-79 are Review rather than Pass, aligns machine-health evidence with the verdict, and exposes a built-in decision-policy self-test.

settings.name: APEX Public Readiness & Self Maintenance
settings.description: Keeps the professional Settings sidebar, adds APEX self-health checks, privacy-safe support snapshot export, restore/cleanup maintenance actions and a one-time non-popup getting-started guide. It creates no startup update success toast or green update panel.
